name: use-code-language
title: useCodeLanguage
description: One remembered code language shared by every code sample on the page.
usage: Code tabs, install commands and code explorers that should all switch together when the visitor picks a language (UseCaseCodeTabs, UseCaseInstallCommand, UseCases and ProductCodeExplorer use it). The pick is kept in storage where allowed and followed across tabs.
avoid: A per-window language state on a page with more than one code sample
Reading storage during render on the server (the hook returns null there)

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
